test_title: PYST 36: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 3 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter - cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter - cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

AGES : YDCO :: FAIR : DXGN :: LIFE : ?
solution:
The positional values of the English alphabet is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d9f2222d13f0d75477f5789fe34c986626f9d54f937ee85ec5f0db5452d8cd8.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

AGES : YDCO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1923cacc591c979edffa0657ed347f7948cf49f3512907b18d6405533e049a72.png] 

FAIR : DXGN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b284c330fd2b39c4b63fcc777cabfb2bd9104a38db372186e4b60d690b40ced.png] 

LIFE : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8bd3e226e71893528ef63b45b66b328f1ab2d10d886969fbd008e1219eda065e.png] 

Hence,** 'option 1'** is the correct answer.
